newsitem.title: UK: SAS Cargo names Jones Europe sales/services head.
newsitem.headline: SAS Cargo names Jones Europe sales/services head.

text.p: Scandinavian airline SAS said it has appointed Howard Jones to the newly-created position of manager cargo sales and services, Europe.
Jones will be responsible for supporting all cargo activities throughout the airline's Europe region, reporting to Henric Nauckhoff, head of SAS Cargo International.
He will retain his current responsibilities as cargo manager for the UK, Ireland and Iceland.

SAS Cargo's European region covers Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, Greece, Iceland, Italy, Israel, Luxembourg, Portugal, Spain, Switzerland and Turkey. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
